ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Use your location to show your position, speed and course while Veetr is open. Recording and sharing start only when you choose them.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Use your location for active tracking or anchor monitoring, including while the screen is locked.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Use your location for active tracking or anchor monitoring, including while the screen is locked.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Use motion sensors to improve speed quality and, when diagnostics are enabled, record motion measurements locally with your trips.
ios.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Sound an alarm if your boat leaves the anchor area or reliable GPS updates stop.
